scope: Validation only. E2/E3 training seeds 0-2 retrained for 40,000 updates, E0's 40,000-clip budget. Each seed is checked at 10k, 20k and 40k, then the three E0 seeds and the six 40k runs are scored together on A40 (job 46804). The D015 test result is recorded separately in results/final-evaluation-d015.json.
config_relation: Each config equals configs/training/diffusion_repeats/<conditioning>_seed<N>.json except steps 40000. The cosine schedule runs over 40,000 updates, so 10k and 20k are mid-schedule checkpoints.
plan_relation: All validation plans have the same cases, action groups, evaluator sources, sampling seeds, dataset and image metrics as the job 46704 plan. Plan hashes differ only through the release path, the frozen comparison.yaml (D014) and, for selection plans, the output folder.

nine_run_validation.E0_identical_to_job_46704: Tracking, all 72 trajectory reports, SSIM/LPIPS with intervals and both action horizons equal job 46704.

gpu_note: Seeds 1-2 were trained and first checked on an L40S node. Rescoring the same checkpoints on A40 changes the counts, so the GPU model affects sampling. Seed 0 was trained and checked on A40 and matches exactly.
